sloka: ज्वलत् पावक संकाशा स्वर्गम् एव जगाम सा ।दिव्यम् आभरण संयुक्ता दिव्य माल्य अनुलेपना ॥३-७४-३३॥
transliteration: jvalat pāvaka saṁkāśā svargam eva jagāma sā ।divyam ābharaṇa saṁyuktā divya mālya anulepanā ॥3-74-33॥

translations.english: With matted locks, tattered bark clothes and deer skin, Sabari consigned her old and emaciated body to the fire at that moment, with the permission of Rama and ascended to heaven, her body glowing like fire.
